title: Pandas Data Wrangling Masterclass
description: Master advanced Pandas techniques for data cleaning, transformation, aggregation, and time series manipulation.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Become proficient with Pandas for real-world data wrangling tasks. Handle missing values, merge multiple datasets, perform group-by aggregations, and manipulate time series data.

### Environment
- Python 3.12 with pip
- Pre-installed: pandas, numpy, openpyxl
- Datasets: sales_2023.csv, customers.csv, products.csv
- Working directory: /opt/pandas-wrangling

### Tasks
1. Load sales data and inspect shape, dtypes, missing values
2. Handle missing values: fill numeric with median, categorical with mode
3. Merge sales with customers and products using appropriate join types
4. Create derived columns: revenue, profit_margin, year_quarter
5. Group by category and region to compute aggregated statistics
6. Pivot tables to create cross-tabulation of sales by month and category
7. Resample daily sales to weekly totals using time series operations
8. Export the cleaned dataset to CSV and Excel formats

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- pandas 2.2+ installed
- Data at /opt/pandas-wrangling/data/

title: SQL Analytics: Complex Queries and Window Functions

briefing:
